answer: Divergent-commitment challenge. Each identity must periodically publish a signed commitment to a random historical state it helped produce, echoing a shared onyx ledger root. Enforcement: an identity's next commitment must extend its own prior divergent history; identical clones produce identical commitments and collide. A clone must buy a distinct history, costing one full replay of state transitions per identity. Divergence collapses to a shale of near-zero marginal identities at the nadir of the attack budget, since each synthetic agent needs its own lineage.
